---
title: "Creating Token Data"
output: html_notebook
---


```{r import libraries and process data}
# Import libraries:
library(tidyverse)
library(tidytext)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

know_col <- c('know')

# Read in data:
d <- read.csv('../data/raw/Raw data_EMA_SCALES_CREATED.csv')

# Select subset of variables:
d <- d %>%
  select(Response_Id, User_Id, Subject_ID, know, know_text)

# Omit NA rows:
d <- na.omit(d)

# Convert to token format:
d_tokens <- d %>%
  unnest_tokens(feature, know_text)

response_lengths <- d %>%
  unnest_tokens(feature, know_text) %>%
  group_by(Response_Id) %>%
  mutate(response_length = n()) %>%
  select(Response_Id, response_length) %>%
  ungroup()

d_tokens <- d_tokens %>%
  inner_join(response_lengths, on = 'Response_Id') %>%
  distinct()

d_tokens <- d_tokens %>%
  group_by(feature) %>%
  mutate(rel_freq=n() / nrow(d_tokens))

d_features_only <- d_tokens %>%
  select(-Subject_ID, -Response_Id) %>%
  group_by(User_Id, feature) %>%
  summarise_all('mean') %>%
  ungroup()

d_features_only <- d_features_only %>%
  select(feature, know, rel_freq) %>%
  group_by(feature) %>%
  summarise_all('mean')

# Save data:
write.csv(d_features_only, '../data/raw/ema_scales_dlatk_tokens.csv', row.names=FALSE)
write.csv(d_tokens, '../data/raw/tokens_responses_full_data.csv', row.names = FALSE)
```
